blocks.text: LVIV, Ukraine — Britain’s Prince Harry made a surprise visit to Ukraine over the weekend, meeting wounded veterans and medics specializing in war injuries and telling them: “You’re going to win the war.” Making his fourth visit to Ukraine since Russia’s 2022 invasion, Prince Harry told wounded soldiers that “the world will continue to support”
